evals.prompt: Prepare a dry-run plan for a 20-second power/thermal capture at 1-second intervals to /tmp/pt-mon.txt. Do not run turbostat or sudo. Show the resolved command, prerequisite checks, confirmation gate, bounded row-count/summary method, and stop guidance.
evals.expected_output: Provide a Planned Monitor summary, fail-closed prerequisites, dry-run confirmation outcome, capture validation method, SysWatt annotation, and cleanup guidance without claiming samples or a log exist.
expectations: Resolves duration=20s, interval=1, /tmp/pt-mon.txt, and the documented PkgTmp/PkgWatt/CorWatt/GFXWatt/RAMWatt/SysWatt columns
Lists script, turbostat, Intel/x86, writable log parent, and sudo probe checks
Uses direct turbostat for non-default interval/log settings and does not edit pt_mon.sh
Renders the Planned Monitor summary before confirmation and states dry-run/declined means no process or log is started
Describes bounded log/row validation, min/mean/max metrics, SysWatt limitation annotation, and stop guidance without claiming capture evidence
